logical_layer: Exact UTF-8 JSONL bytes; per-event sequence contiguous from0. All keys/values/order retained. Explicit nonfinite tags, no JSON NaN/Infinity or duplicate keys. No sampling, renumbering or statistics substitution.

physical_blocks.event_boundary: whole records only; oversized-within-limit record gets a dedicated block

indices.blocks: blocks.index.jsonl; append-only committed per-block receipt, ordinal/header/file SHA and contiguous sequence range
indices.retained_state: producer active budget slots and current event/operation state only; indices never kept as whole lists by producer/reader

array_snapshots.token: Original v1 {array:{dtype,shape,content_sha256}}; occurrence identity in sidecar, not inserted into logical payload
array_snapshots.hash_only: Detached copy hashed; inventory entry, no blob bytes
array_snapshots.full_capture: Same logical token; unique raw lossless blob per occurrence, no dedup, no pickle
array_snapshots.supported: non-object, non-structured NumPy dtypes preserving dtype.str/endian/shape and C-order raw bits; unsupported types fail before copy, never coerce

resource_policy.units: Conservative 4KiB-rounded file allocations with one-page slack per file, checked against actual st_blocks. Includes payload/header/index/receipt/summary/marker/pending files; no-replace hardlink aliases count once. Not filesystem quota.
resource_policy.memory: bounded decoded/raw block buffers, current JSON record, <=64MiB detached array and <=4096 pending descriptors; no all-events list or all-index list. Python/NumPy allocator and caller memory are not a hard process RSS quota. Synthetic RSS is measured separately.
resource_policy.storage_failure: invalid capture, no formal completion. Standalone module raises; future Observer adapter fault isolation is NOT implemented in this phase.
resource_policy.index_preallocation_reserve: Before append: 2x logical index bytes plus64KiB, rounded plus page; never drop previously observed index allocation. This allowance remains inside4GiB, not extra space. Actual st_blocks is still checked; not a filesystem quota.

publication.method: write unique .pending, flush/fsync/close, os.link to final (atomic EEXIST no replacement). No fallible cleanup after publish.
publication.crash_policy: unclosed indices, partial blocks/close, orphan/missing/duplicate/unrecognized artifacts or mismatched aliases reject full validation.

completion.block_integrity_complete: all accepted physical data flushed/indexed, no faults/pending logical array token
completion.business_process_complete: both declared expected operations began/completed in order, normal end and bound receipt envelope agree
completion.marker: observer_complete.json binds SHA of closed summary only if BOTH states true
completion.prefix: complete blocks + missing business tail yield physical=true/business=false and no formal marker. Explicit prefix reader can inspect but cannot promote to complete.
completion.receipt_envelope: Standalone tests use {normal_end:true,operation_ids:[U1,U2],payload:...}; a real business receipt adapter is deferred to P4 review.

reader.block_decode: header lengths/bounds before payload allocation; max-length zlib decode rejects surplus, trailing/unconsumed bytes and bad hashes
reader.events: iterate one record at a time; full validation requires exhausting iterator
reader.arrays: dtype/shape/count/occurrence/file/content hashes verified in chunks; no whole-array read needed
reader.comparison: strict decoded byte/event equality and full raster integrity; no field/RNG/path exclusions
reader.range_access: sequence ranges stored; optimized random-range API not implemented or claimed
